## Accent-Strong Color Decision: TEAL

Implemented as `.doc b.accent-strong, .doc strong.accent-strong { color: var(--accent-teal); font-weight: 600; }` — `.doc`-prefixed (0,2,1) and declared last so it outranks the scoped brightening rules. **Rationale (documented in the CSS design comment and README):** the website's own body-prose accent-strong is teal; accent-strong here is voice/brand emphasis (the chrome family — prose links in these same paragraphs are already teal), not an in-content interactive element, so the teal-chrome/indigo-content token split is respected. It appears only inside pure prose paragraphs, never beside status-colored cells (the pass-green-proximity concern that keeps teal out of data surfaces). Contrast 8.78:1 per the WP8 re-audit. A bonus correctness note recorded: w600 is the heaviest DM Sans weight the page actually loads, so default `<b>` 700 was being browser-synthesized — the new rule also fixes that.
